scope: read-only installed SDK / original exported graph review; no board access or compile

notes: Only first two input type tuples; no output type or bias certification
Signed INT8/INT16 alias from actual SDK headers; not bitwidth inferred from name
Direct ELF section/symbol table independently parsed; no library execution/graph compile

fp16_bridge_counterexample.warning: not lossless; no bridge compiled or recommended as metadata-only

necessary_conditions: Signed INT16/INT8 ranges including negative endpoint must remain unchanged; bit width alone is insufficient.
Scalar scale is exact finite positive f32 2^-fl, zero_point is integer 0; no minmax recalibration, epsilon, unsigned rebias or FP16 bridge.
Round-to-nearest-even and saturation/clipping endpoints must match at every quantization boundary, including half-step and overflow cases.
PC scales and zero-point vectors retain bytes, output-channel correspondence and layout permutation; channel_dim numeric value may change with shape, not semantic axis.
Actual exported constant byte slices, dtype and dequantization scale must match; source YAML and FP32 weights alone are insufficient.
Actual exported bias scale equals input_scale times per-channel weight_scale; source bias YAML is not authoritative.
Original output quantizer and external tensor contracts must remain, and new conversion/reshape nodes must be SDK-supported.
Accumulator width, reduction ordering, requantization multiplier approximation and intermediate saturation can change despite matched input grids.
required_measurements_before_qualificati: Successful final NB generation with frozen SHA and full external port verification.
Same canonical input single-block A-B-A repeated timing; actual output f32 files all five ports finite/hash/per-port relativeL2 maxabs and drift.
Actual SDK conversions checked on sign endpoints, zero, half-step ties and overflow boundaries where possible.
Full24-layer paired full-vocabulary logits/top1 margins, natural short and long heldout quality; token parity is not numerical equivalence or task correctness.
Capacity512 versus C1280 is an independent variable; do not combine shape and operator effects without paired evidence.
Full target8cells plus boundary lengths for TTFT/prefill; speechRAG residency, resources, release0 and longer stability separately qualified.
